event_centres.source:
def event_centres(period, epoch, start, stop):
    first = math.floor((start - epoch) / period) - 1
    last = math.ceil((stop - epoch) / period) + 1
    return [(cycle, epoch + cycle * period) for cycle in range(first, last + 1)]
